# db_connection v2.10.1 - Table of Contents

> Database connection behaviour for database transactions and connection pooling

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [DBConnection](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.md): A behaviour module for implementing efficient database connection
client processes, pools and transactions.
- [DBConnection.ConnectionPool](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.ConnectionPool.md): The default connection pool.
- [DBConnection.LogEntry](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.LogEntry.md): Struct containing log entry information.
- [DBConnection.Ownership](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.Ownership.md): A DBConnection pool that requires explicit checkout and checkin
as a mechanism to coordinate between processes.
- [DBConnection.PrepareStream](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.PrepareStream.md)
- [DBConnection.Query](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.Query.md): The `DBConnection.Query` protocol is responsible for preparing and
encoding queries.
- [DBConnection.Stream](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.Stream.md)
- [DBConnection.TelemetryListener](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.TelemetryListener.md): A connection listener that emits telemetry events for connection and disconnection

- Exceptions
  - [DBConnection.ConnectionError](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.ConnectionError.md): A generic connection error exception.
  - [DBConnection.EncodeError](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.EncodeError.md)
  - [DBConnection.OwnershipError](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.OwnershipError.md): An exception for when errors with ownership occur.

  - [DBConnection.TransactionError](https://db-connection.hexdocs.pm/DBConnection.TransactionError.md)
